# Original upstream notices

These files were retrieved on 2026-09-21 from the official source repositories
listed below. Their contents are unchanged. [manifest.json](manifest.json)
records the exact source commits, file URLs, SHA-256 hashes and source archives.

| Source | Version | Included material |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Qt Base](qtbase/) | 6.11.2 | License texts, third-party copyright notices, Qt attribution JSON and files referenced by its `LicenseFile` fields |
| [Qt SVG](qtsvg/) | 6.11.2 | License and attribution files |
| [Qt Image Formats](qtimageformats/) | 6.11.2 | License and attribution files |
| [Qt for Python / Shiboken](pyside-setup/) | 6.11.2 | Original license and attribution files |
| [VTK](vtk/) | 9.5.2 | Project and ThirdParty/Utilities license and copyright notices |
| [PyInstaller](pyinstaller/) | 6.22.3 | Original license texts, including the bootloader exception |

This is a source-tree notice collection covering optional components as well as
the modules Atlaxis uses. For example, a Qt commercial-license reference in the
source tree is not a commercial license granted to Atlaxis or a requirement to
purchase one. Select the appropriate offered terms for each distributed module;
Atlaxis uses the GPLv3 option for Qt/PySide where available.

Attribution JSON retains upstream copyright statements and identifies which
components the license texts cover. Some source trees use JSON containing
unescaped multiline strings; these originals have not been normalized.

This collection is not the full corresponding source. The source archives and
build requirements are described in [licensing.md](../../../docs/licensing.md).
Inspect the actual distribution for any additional native dependencies and
preserve their notices and required source access as well.
